newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL issue price to be set on May 8 - APTF.
newsitem.headline: MOL issue price to be set on May 8 - APTF.

text.p: The subscription price for Hungarian oil company MOL 's shares will be published on May 8 in two national newspapers and the official gazette of the Budapest Stock Exchange.

Bourse and money market supervision APTF said in a statement that subscriptions in the domestic public offer will run from May 12 to May 23, but can be closed any time after May 14 once subscriptions have matched the size of the share offer.
APV is offering 984,000 shares to domestic investors, representing one percent of MOL's share capital, and will supplement it with another percent in case of strong demand.
APV places a 12.5 percent stake, with a 2.5 percent over-allotment option, to institutional investors privately.
